elements.name: Slider Explanatory Footnotes
elements.text: Top skating speed in metres per second. Higher is faster and harder to control. (3 .. 16) How fast the puck leaves the stick after a shot, in metres per second. (5 .. 40) How slippery the ice is. 0 never slows down, 0.015 is real ice. (0 .. 0.1) How sharp the opposing bots are. 0 is clumsy, 1 is sharp. (0 .. 1) How sharply skaters turn, in radians per second. (1 .. 12)

Period countdown timer or match clock.
